description: Well, this is not my usual sunset video post though. I spotted this massive black ring hovering in the sky at around 5:55 pm before if dissipated into the sunset. I thought at first it was a swarm but it seems to be a giant smoke ring? I’ve never seen anything like that before, though.  Doesn’t help that I literally just flipped the channel after watching the UFO segment of Unsolved Mysteries when I spotted the strange shape in the horizon from my window 🛸
